concerns.text: The plan includes a 'Constitution Check' table (I. Reproducibility, II. Verified Accuracy, …) that is not referenced by any FR or SC in the specification. This is an over‑reach element; the spec does not require a separate constitution‑status audit in the implementation plan.

The 'Project Structure' diagram enumerates directories (specs/, data/, code/, outputs/, tests/) but no functional requirement in the spec maps to this artifact. While useful documentation, it is a plan element without a corresponding FR/SC, thus constitutes over‑reach.
